title: I Left the Bakery Review With the Wrong-Name Ticket Photo

parts.text: I called my number at 11:14 a.m. and the counter handed me someone else's rye. The ticket said LENA. Mine said my name in block letters. I was twenty-eight, regular, standing in a line that made me look like I owned the mix-up. I photographed the ticket, the rye, and the board that said SAY THE NAME. Then I left the review with the wrong-name photo. At 11:22 the owner pinged a refund and a reprint. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. They reprint names now. I keep the photo. The counter finally looks like a ticket, not a guess.
